_about: v2.2 Neutral rework, unit N2 — the REVIEWED expectations for every card the rework has changed so far (N1's Swift / Magnetic Core / Keen Eye retirement carried over unchanged; N2 adds XP Boost's ladder and Overclock's copy), grounded in docs/v2.2-neutral-design-spec.md §2 and the R1/R5 rulings (N0 §9). The frozen legacy fixtures are never edited; ParityAttribution builds the expected current documents from them plus this overlay. `cards` = dump-shaped records of every card whose AUTHORED record changed (copy or ladder); `expectedDeltas` = the reviewed PlayerStats effects of the cards whose EFFECT changed (a card in `cards` with no entry here changed copy only and must keep its legacy effect exactly); `addedFields` = PlayerStats stored fields that did not exist in the legacy record, with their default leaves. Supersedes n1-overlay.json (kept as evidence).
fieldsNote: N1: Swift adds its rungs to moveSpeedMultiplier (0.08, 0.12, 0.15); Magnetic Core adds its rungs to pickupRadiusMultiplier (0.15, 0.15, 0.20) and SETS magneticCoreSpeedBoost (0.10, 0.20, 0.30); Keen Eye's +0.20 radius is gone. N2: XP Boost adds its rungs to xpMultiplier (0.25, 0.25, 0.00) and at T3 sets runLevelCap 15 → 20 and adds 1 to grantedLevelsPending. Overclock's effect (overclockActive) is unchanged; its +35% attack speed / +15% damage are computed properties read while its timer runs, not stored fields.
addedFieldsNote: PlayerStats stored fields introduced in N2 (the run level cap and XP Boost's owed level). They appear in fieldPaths/defaultState and change only through XP Boost T3.

neutral_1.name: Swift
neutral_1.detail: Permanent movement speed: +8%, then +20%, then +35% (totals). Adds to your other movement bonuses.

v13_magnetic_core.name: Magnetic Core
v13_magnetic_core.description: +15% XP pull; XP gives a speed burst
v13_magnetic_core.detail: XP orbs are pulled from 15% / 30% / 50% farther (totals). Each XP orb collected grants +10% / +20% / +30% movement speed for 1.5s; another pickup refreshes the time, never the strength. Health orbs are never magnetized.

neutral_5.name: XP Boost
neutral_5.detail: Run XP gain: +25%, then +50% (totals). The run's level cap is 15; tier 3 raises it to 20 and grants one full level-up right away (card and stat), keeping the XP you have. XP collected at the cap is banked.

v17_overclock.name: Overclock
v17_overclock.detail: After each level-up, when play resumes: +35% movement speed, +35% attack speed and +15% damage for 3 seconds of play. Another level-up refreshes the time; it never stacks.

expectedDeltasNote: Pairs are from the DEFAULT state (byte for byte); from a mid-run state the same per-tier CHANGE is required. XP Boost T3's xpMultiplier rung is +0.00 (T3 keeps +50%), so it does not appear in T3's diff; T3's cap is a max() to 20 and the granted level is += 1.

retiredNotes.neutral_2: v2.2 N1 Neutral (Keen Eye, merged into Magnetic Core)
